sentences.text: Shannon Emery Lee -LRB- born April 19 , 1969 -RRB- is an American actress , martial artist and businesswoman .

She is the daughter of martial arts film star Bruce Lee and Linda Lee Cadwell , the granddaughter of Cantonese opera singer Lee Hoi-Chuen , and the younger sister of Brandon Lee .	Bruce Lee	Bruce Lee	Linda Lee Cadwell	Linda Lee Cadwell	Brandon Lee	Brandon Lee	Lee Hoi-Chuen	Lee Hoi-Chuen
